newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume rises, prices lower.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume rises, prices lower.

text.p: Prices on the Istanbul gold exchange continued to slide on Friday in line with world trends and volume firmed to 708 kg from Thursday's 630 kg due to fresh demand fuelled by lower prices in early trade, dealers said.
Gold closed at $364.50 an ounce and 1,276,000 lira per gramme, down from Thursday's $368.60 and 1,283,400 lira respectively.
"Some local traders bought gold to take advantage of lower world prices to close their short positions on expectations that the $365 support would hold," said Kaan Pekin from Toprakbank.
"But this support was broken which caused demand to weaken in the second session," he added.
Traded volume plunged to 135 kg in the afternoon from 573 in the morning session. 70.3 percent of the total turnover was in lira terms.
